commit.author: drdave-flexnteos <flexnetos@de-flex.net>

lines.content: - [ ] If no compliant hook exists, the runbook says durable reboot autostart is unsupported and documents the manual per-session command without overstating persistence.
- [ ] Relevant Nix checks and runner tests pass with no system-depth writes.
## Analysis & recommendation (2026-07-24)
**Scrub done.** The systemd unit/packaging/checks are removed from the canonical runner
(`flexnetos_runner/nix/gha-runner`, `verify.mjs` 33/33, forbids `systemd|systemctl|enable-linger|
loginctl`). Per-session start is the nix-store closure `nix run .#service`. So the "remove systemd"
half of this task is COMPLETE; what remains is the auto-start *decision*.
**The hard constraint, stated plainly.** Truly *unattended* auto-start at raw boot inherently needs
a system-level trigger — `systemd --user`+linger, a system service, `cron @reboot`, or a
display-manager autostart. **All are system depths.** Under NO_SYSTEM_DEPTHS (exception: Nix store)
there is **no pure-nix-store way to start a user process at boot with no human/session event.**
So the honest choice is between two shapes, neither of which is systemd:
1. **Session-triggered (recommended).** Start the runner when the yazelix session/`yzx enter` comes
up (the front door the owner uses), via a nix-store launcher that runs `nix run .#service`,
guarded by a pidfile (rUv's `daemon-autostart.ts` pattern: single-instance via a signal-0
liveness check, TTL/idle-bounded, opt-out flag — `ruflo/v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/services/
daemon-autostart.ts`). No systemd, no linger. Reuses the yzx-iso T7 "boot re-attach" plane if
wired there. Trade-off: the runner is up whenever the owner is in their session, not during
headless-no-login windows.
2. **Not at all.** Accept per-session manual start (`nix run .#service`); document that headless
unattended boot-start is out of scope because it cannot be done without a system depth.
**Recommendation: option 1 (session-triggered pidfile launcher).** It is the maximal persistence
achievable within NO_SYSTEM_DEPTHS and matches how the owner actually reaches the machine (yazelix).
Implementation lands in the canonical repo (`flexnetos_runner`) + a yazelix session hook; verify by
starting a fresh session and asserting `flexnetos-nix` reaches `online` with no systemd artifact.
## Spec References
- [[tasks/gha-runner-expand-polish]] — completed proof whose user-systemd persistence claim is superseded by this correction.

changes.title: Decide Nix-Native Runner Persistence Without System Depths

commit.message:
persistence task: nix-native analysis + recommendation (session-triggered pidfile launcher)

Scrub complete; the remaining decision is auto-start shape. Raw-boot unattended start needs a
system-depth (systemd/linger/cron@reboot/DM-autostart) — forbidden. Recommend session-triggered
launcher (nix run .#service, ruflo daemon-autostart pidfile pattern) as max persistence within
NO_SYSTEM_DEPTHS; alternative is 'not at all'.

Refs [[tasks/gha-runner-nix-native-persistence]]
